questions: Did the session begin at sunset in Brandonsford, with Dunk at Farmer Gill's farm and the other adventurers in town?
Did Dunk offer Farmer Gill 20 gold for Seamus?
Did Farmer Gill tell Dunk that he could not part cheaply with Seamus while his sons were away, but would lower the price once they returned?
Did Dr Uriah carry the party's physical map?
Did Dr Uriah plan to secretly copy the map during downtime, with the GM saying he could do it that night?
Did Sir Phidipaldi stay at the Golden Egg Tavern for the night?
Did Trout and Dr Uriah take rooms at the Clumsy Fox Tavern for the night?
Did Squints say he was a river halfling newly arrived in town, looking for an adventuring crew and his first big break?
Did Trout invite Squints to meet his companions the next morning?
Did Squints agree to return the next morning to meet Trout's companions?
Did Dunk give up sleep to scout Warwick's closed smithy after dark?
Did Dr Uriah stake out the river to watch for the Clurichen and follow it?
Did Sir Phidipaldi wait in the Golden Egg Tavern's basement hoping to catch the thief that Quinn had promised to pay him for finding?
Did Trout go spear-fishing at the river outside town and catch several fish while hidden among the reeds?
Did Dunk see a luminous mithril chain shirt that appeared magical through Warwick's shop window?
Did a frazzled woman approach Warwick's home, spot Dunk, become startled, and pretend she was going elsewhere?
Did Dunk follow a woman away from Warwick's home?
Did Dunk conclude that the woman he followed was Ingrid, the alchemist?
Did a Clurichen swim across the river towing a corked jug and drag it ashore?
Did the Clurichen turn invisible after reaching the shore?
Did Dr Uriah secretly follow the Clurichen's footprints?
Did Trout emerge from concealment and follow Dr Uriah and the invisible Clurichen?
Did the invisible Clurichen's passage cause the Golden Egg Tavern's exterior basement door to clatter open and shut?
Did Ingrid say she sells witch powder that makes magical objects glow?
Did Ingrid confess that she admires Warwick from afar, leaves him gifts on his windowsill every night, and is too frightened to speak to him or let him know she watches him sleep?
Did Dunk offer to help Ingrid enter Warwick's home if she would unlock the front door for him?
Did Sir Phidipaldi cover the Golden Egg Tavern's basement floor with marbles?
Did the invisible Clurichen slip on the marbles Sir Phidipaldi left, and become visible?
Did Dr Uriah kick open the basement door and throw ink into the room to reveal the invisible thief?
Did Trout trap the Clurichen beneath his bag of fish?
Did the Clurichen identify himself as Naggeneen after being caught?
Did Naggeneen plead to be released when captured, saying he only liked to drink?
Did Naggeneen offer his pot of gold or a secret in exchange for being released?
Did Sir Phidipaldi call Quinn to the basement and announce that the alcohol thief had been caught?
Did Trout present the captured Naggeneen and his alcohol-reeking jug to Quinn as proof?
Did someone say that Naggeneen, rather than Bentley, had been stealing the Golden Egg Tavern's alcohol?
Did Quinn hang the bag containing Naggeneen behind the bar?
Did Quinn pay Sir Phidipaldi, Trout, and Dr Uriah 33 gold each?
Did Dunk suggest that Ingrid make a sleeping potion so Warwick would not wake while she watched him?
Did Ingrid tell Dunk she could make him a potion if he brought her faun wine from the Fauns Grove north of town?
Do the trees in the Fauns Grove bleed potent red wine instead of sap?
Did Ingrid thank Dunk for keeping her romance secret and tell him that she owed him?
Did Father William regard Dr Uriah with open prejudice because Dr Uriah is a Dagonite?

Did Father William tell Dr Uriah that Brother Dirk had already set out to kill the dragon, first traveling to Brandon's Barrow—about a day's walk away—to recover the magic sword buried with Sir Brandon?
Did Father William tell Dr Uriah that Ingrid, whom he dismissed as a pagan, relies on a witch in the woods for her potions?
Did Father William mark the locations of Brandon's Barrow and the witch's home on Dr Uriah's map?
Did George warn Sir Phidipaldi that the young black dragon lairs at the foot of the northern mountains?
Did George warn Sir Phidipaldi that the dragon cannot fly yet but soon will?
Did George warn Sir Phidipaldi that the dragon killed all of his companions and forced him to amputate his own poisoned arm?
Did George warn Sir Phidipaldi that the dragon's jaws drip lethal poison, that it spits sulfur, and that its black scales resisted every arrow and sword his group used?
Did George say he doubted that Eric the Reeve actually had the promised 1,000 gold?
Did George say that only Sir Brandon had ever killed such a dragon, supposedly using a magic sword given to him by a fairy?

Did Trout offer Squints a place as his junior assistant in the party's Halfling Corps, on the condition that Squints fund himself, accept second pick of treasure, take orders from Trout, and limit himself to three requests for advice per day?
Did Squints eagerly accept Trout's terms and join the adventuring party?
Did Ingrid say that fairies have increasingly emerged from hiding since the dragon appeared?
Did Ingrid mention her forest-dwelling friend Vivian, who communes with nature?
Did Dunk find fauns dancing, playing music, and drinking heavily from golden goblets in the Fauns Grove?
Did Dunk join the fauns' revel, dancing and drinking their wine after they invited him?
Did Dunk withstand a first drink of faun wine without becoming drunk, astonishing the fauns?
Did Dunk remain conscious after drinking a second cup of faun wine?
Did Dunk trade a rabbit's foot to a faun in exchange for a necklace flask of faun wine?
Did Dunk tell the party that Warwick owns moonlit, shimmering armor that might help against the dragon?
Did Dunk tell the party that he had a plan to acquire Warwick's armor that night?
Did Dunk take some of the faun's wine, diluting the rest, before giving it to Ingrid?
Did Dunk deliver the diluted faun wine to Ingrid so she could begin making a sleeping potion intended for Warwick?
Did the party, accompanied by Squints, travel north through the forest toward Brandon's Barrow?
Did the party find a giant-sized stone cottage with a horrible roaring sound coming from within?
Did Squints report seeing a giant inside the cottage beside a human-sized, wriggling sack pinned to the wall?
Did Trout order Squints to enter through the window, remove the sack, and escape without waking the giant?
Did Squints sneak into the giant's cottage and free Brother Dirk, who was found bound and gagged inside a hanging sack?
Did Squints and Brother Dirk wake the Giant?
Did Dr Uriah smash a window to divert the giant's attention away from Squints and Brother Dirk?
Did Trout accidentally strike Squints with a sling stone he had fired at the giant?
Did the party escape the cottage with Squints and Brother Dirk, with the giant chasing them until it eventually gave up?
Did Brother Dirk thank the party for saving him from being cooked in the giant's stew?
Did Brother Dirk explain that he had been traveling to Brandon's Barrow to recover a sword and save the town?
Did Brother Dirk say that after his ordeal he would rather return home than continue on to Brandon's Barrow?
Did Sir Phidipaldi insist that Brother Dirk accompany them because they were also traveling to Brandon's Barrow?
Did Farmer Gill offer Dunk a free bed in the barn for the night?
Were Lady Hilda and Drop Dead Ned among the adventurers gathered at the Clumsy Fox Tavern?
Was Malzazarik the Magnificent a boisterous, whimsical wizard at the Clumsy Fox Tavern?
Was Warwick's home and smithy covered with horseshoes, rabbit's feet, and nailed-up clovers?
Was Ingrid startled and embarrassed that Dunk saw her near Warwick's home?
Did Ingrid say she sells mandrake root tea that heals wounds?
Did Ingrid say she sells essence of wolfsbane?
Did Dr Uriah go to Brandonsford's church to investigate its antiquities?
Did Sir Phidipaldi go to question George about the black dragon?
Did Ingrid denounce Father William, saying the church suppresses the secrets of the wood folk?
Did Dunk claim that the rabbit's foot he traded had once kept a child from his village safe at night?
